content: No ready-made QuPath library exists for peri-cellular local-background subtraction; it is a known community pain point (image.sc forum threads on QuPath autofluorescence + IF background subtraction) with no single canonical script. Must be hand-composed from QuPath primitives: RoiTools.buffer (dilate/erode ROI by pixel distance) + RoiTools.subtract (remove neighbor ROIs) + ObjectMeasurements.addIntensityMeasurements (sample mean pixel intensity in an arbitrary ROI treated as Compartments.CELL on a throwaway PathObjects.createDetectionObject).
